title: Polybee F3-Swarm: Heterogeneous Edge-Cloud LLM Architecture with Calibrated System-1 Invariance, Symbolic Anchoring, and Rashomon-Guided Tier-3 Residual Repair
description: Official open-source benchmark, reproduction suite, and technical report (TR-2026-F3S-05) for Polybee F3-Swarm v1.5. A 3-tier heterogeneous LLM swarm (Qwen2.5-0.5B, 1.5B, and Coder-3B) achieving 96.7% SOTA accuracy across 30 Portuguese administrative, financial, and programmatic edge operations under strict active RAM limits (< 1.5 GiB in edge). Includes full telemetry, physical benchmarks, and audited results for Labs 01 to 05.
notes: Polybee AI Research Technical Report TR-2026-F3S-05. Audited telemetry and reproduction scripts covering Labs 01 to 05.
